plain.title: Literature review
plain.text: Sleep and stressSleep consolidates memory (Smith, 2020). Exam stress rises in the first year (Smith & Lee, 2020), and it lingers (Smith et al., 2020). Smith (2020) found the same in a second sample, and the World Health Organization (2022) agrees (World Health Organization, 2022).Homework helps little (Lee, 2018).
